useCase: Detecting physically impossible reflexións in generado por IA images, especially in eyes and glossy surfaces
mechanism: Analiza specular highlights and reflexións in eyes, glasses, metallic surfaces, and water for physical consistency. Verifica that reflexión geometry matches the scene's light source positions and object arrangements. AI models frequently generate physically impossible reflexións that violate optical laws.
accuracy: Moderada - 70-82% on images with visible reflective surfaces
name: Análisis de Consistencia de Reflexión
source: O'Brien & Farid (2012) - Exposing Photo Manipulation with Inconsistent Reflections, ACM TOMM
algorithm: Specular Highlight Analysis + Reflection Symmetry Check
parameters: Detection: specular highlight segmentation, Eye reflexión: corneal reflexión análisis, Surface: BRDF consistency check, Symmetry: bilateral reflexión matching
description: Examina reflexións in eyes, glasses, and surfaces for physical precisión. AI models frequently generate physically impossible or inconsistent reflexións.

references.title: O'Brien, J.F. & Farid, H. (2012). Exposing Photo Manipulation with Inconsistent Reflections. ACM TOMM.
Hu, S. et al. (2021). Exposing GAN-generated Faces Using Inconsistent Corneal Specular Highlights. ICASSP.

strengths:
• Based on physical optics laws
• Very effective for face/portrait análisis
• Eye reflexións are strong autenticidad indicators
• Detecta subtle physical impossibilities
limitations:
• Requires visible reflective surfaces
• Low-resolución images reduce detección ability
• Complex scenes with multiple reflexións are challenging
• Not applicable to matte/diffuse surfaces
